purpose: Separate exact source-authoritative proper-name literals from ordinary generative language so character-level identity fidelity does not depend on semantic or phonetic reconstruction.

requirements: semantic character descriptions reference identity_id rather than alternate spellings
if explicit name is emitted, canonical_literal is copied exactly
pronouns or omission remain allowed when natural and source-consistent

audit_rules: BLOCK if a canonical identity is represented to writer only through romanization or semantic description when a source-authoritative Chinese literal exists.
BLOCK if the mechanism locks ordinary prose words or creates a style template.
BLOCK if Phase406 focal cost-carrier semantics are changed.
BLOCK if Phase405 non-focal ownership or abstract-live-vector firewall is weakened.
BLOCK if Phase404 response transaction is changed.
BLOCK if cleanup, retry, A2, second window or best-of-N is introduced.
